name: Onagawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Onagawa town emblem in white: an outlined ring formed of three interlocking loops.
history: Municipal flag of Onagawa, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 April 1956.

features.role: Onagawa town emblem — an outlined ring formed of three interlocking loops
